recent_posts.title: Flutter animation showcase 1: Crafting an elastic bouncing ball tab with canvas
recent_posts.summary: Learn how to create an engaging animation in Flutter featuring a bouncing ball interacting with a tab bar. This guide breaks down the process into manageable steps, from drawing basic shapes on a canvas to creating complex animations using Bezier curves. Explore the fundamentals of custom animations and bring your UI designs to life.

recent_posts.title: Redesigning Vymo’s experience to empower field sales professionals
recent_posts.summary: Vymo has reimagined its sales engagement platform by integrating map-based features to help field sales professionals manage their activities more efficiently. Key enhancements include optimized route suggestions, nearby opportunities identification, timely nudges, and a new end-of-day summary. The redesign addresses core pain points like inefficient route planning and mobile accessibility, aiming for a more intuitive and productive user experience.

recent_posts.title: The Good and Bad UX Practices by Netflix
recent_posts.summary: The post highlights the evolution of user experience (UX) in media consumption, focusing on Netflix's UX practices. It praises Netflix for features like profile passcodes, the Skip Intro button, and a simple user interface. However, it also criticizes Netflix for issues such as password sharing vulnerabilities, lack of login notifications, inaccessibility on mobile browsers, and account deletion upon subscription cancellation. The author emphasizes the importance of continuous UX improvement and user privacy in maintaining a successful platform.

recent_posts.title: A Designer’s Guide to UI/UX Patterns for AI Products: Series 2 — Is your AI a Guide, Companion, or Driver?
recent_posts.summary: This post explores how AI shapes user experiences in digital products through three core patterns: Guide, Companion, and Driver. It discusses how each role affects the onboarding process and ongoing user interactions. Additionally, it highlights how AI can enhance web accessibility, especially for users with visual impairments, by improving screen reader interactions.

recent_posts.title: UX design isn’t dead, you’re just confused
recent_posts.summary: The UX design industry faces a challenging landscape marked by confusion over design roles, ambiguous hiring practices, and a disconnect between business needs and design value. Despite claims that UX is a dead industry, it continues to evolve with new technologies and changing market dynamics. The post highlights the importance of aligning design with business goals and the necessity for designers to understand the broader business context to make a meaningful impact.

recent_posts.title: Mastering Digital Marketing in 2024: Strategies, Insights, and Trends
recent_posts.summary: Digital marketing continues to evolve rapidly, driven by technological advancements and new privacy regulations. Strategies include staying informed about digital trends, being agile with marketing approaches, and prioritizing high-quality content. Businesses must create cohesive omnichannel strategies and offer value to adapt to savvy consumers. Additionally, data-driven decision-making, combined with creativity, is critical for impactful marketing. Emphasizing transparency, security, and personalized engagement helps build trust and foster deeper customer relationships.

recent_posts.title: Future of UX - Key Trends and Innovations
recent_posts.summary: Innovative UX trends such as AI-powered design, human-centered ethics, microinteractions, voice user interfaces, zero friction UX, and emotional design are reshaping the future of user experience. These trends prioritize personalization, ethical design, engagement through small details, hands-free interaction, effortless usability, and emotional connections, ultimately enhancing the digital user experience.

recent_posts.title: Top 5 No-Code Website Builders in 2025!

recent_posts.title: A guide to requirements engineering
recent_posts.summary: Requirements engineering is essential for any project, comprising five key stages: elicitation, analysis, documentation, validation, and management. These phases ensure project requirements are comprehensive, viable, prioritized, consistent, well-documented, and validated to align with stakeholder needs. Effective management of requirements involves maintaining traceability and adapting to project methodologies, whether linear or iterative.

recent_posts.title: Case study: WhatsApp scheduled message feature
recent_posts.summary: This post delves into the design process and user research behind creating a scheduled message feature for WhatsApp. Inspired by a personal experience, the feature aims to help users send timely messages by allowing them to compose and schedule messages for later delivery. Key insights were gathered from informal interviews, and prototypes were created and tested for intuitive use. Future enhancements like recurring messages and templates are also discussed.
